title: Move the carried-failure parsing and brief rendering out of acceptance_evaluation.rs into its own module
outcome: Low from the Claude reviewer of w-f7620f648ea8, round 2 (delegation-333b3120-43ca-4854-be2a-c6d9e5723454). The carried-failure change grows src/acceptance_evaluation.rs by about 420 lines, to about 2 400, while the project is splitting large files. The carried-failure reading (EngramShowEvaluationForEvaluation, the EngramCarriedFailure* types, AcceptanceCarriedFailure, AcceptanceNewerFailure, acceptance_carried_failure, acceptance_blocking_verdicts) and its rendering (acceptance_brief_carried_failure, acceptance_brief_failed_contract) form one unit with few dependencies, and its tests are already in their own file. The split should be a pure code move into src/acceptance_evaluation_carried_failure.rs, with the provenance header CLAUDE.md asks for.
acceptance: The carried-failure types and functions live in their own module with a header naming what it owns, what it does not, and the file it came from; the move is behaviour-preserving and the acceptance-evaluation tests pass unchanged.
